text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-are you okay? It's bett'r to shuffle<n>your feet
when you're walk'n across<n>snowy roads.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
S'right! You won't topple ov'r if you take<n>short
steps, slide your feet, and lean<n>forw'rd.

text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I had no idea... It's practically the<n>opposite
of how models walk down the<n>runway.

text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
text_block_list.text:
So be my teacher, okay? When you say<n>"lean
forward," do you mean like this?

text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, don't overreact. Come on, teach<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Uh... Go ahead and bend your<n>knees a
t'nsy bit more... uh, if you<n>please.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, move your center of gravity forw'rd.<n>Oth'rwise
you'll slip backwards and<n>smack your head.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine. Focus on moving forw'rd if<n>you fall.
That way, ya won't hurt yourself<n>too badly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Stay alert, and icy roads are noth'n to<n>fear.
Walking on 'em can even help train<n>your low'r
body!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-y-you really mean that? If it helps you<n>out, you
can ask me 'bout this kinda<n>stuff whenev'r you
fancy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Today's my opportunity to repay you for<n>always
teach'n me about city life!
